description: End-to-end verification scenarios for shopping workflows. Each scenario combines 2-3 capabilities tested in training, with relaxed hard assertions to ensure rubric evaluation runs.

tasks.description_for_judge: [E2E Level 1] Open eBay, search, view a product detail. Tests app launch + text input + tap navigation as a flow.
tasks.prompt: Open the eBay app, search for 'bluetooth headphones', then tap the first product in the results to see its detail page.

rubric.check: Search for headphones was executed and results shown.
Final screenshot shows a product detail page (price, image, buy/watchlist buttons visible).
Agent followed the steps in order: open app -> search -> tap product (not random skipping).

tasks.description_for_judge: [E2E Level 2] Search, scroll through results, then view a product further down the list. Tests scroll calibration in a real workflow.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay app, search for 'phone case'. Scroll down at least once to see more options, then tap any product to view its detail page.

rubric.check: Search for phone case was executed.
Agent scrolled the results page at least once.
Agent took a screenshot after scrolling to confirm content changed.
Final screenshot shows a product detail page (not the list view).

tasks.description_for_judge: [E2E Level 3] Full browse-back-browse loop. Tests navigation discipline with state verification.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay app, search for 'usb cable', tap any product to view it, then navigate back to the search results, and tap a different product. Each screen transition should be verified by screenshot.

rubric.check: Agent opened a product detail page from search results.
Agent used back gesture or button to return to results.
Screenshot after back action shows search results list (not home, not detail).
Agent opened a different product after returning to results.
Agent took screenshots between each navigation step.
